title: Eywa API v1
description: Requests a consumer sends to Eywa's api.sock, and the messages Eywa sends back. Each is one JSON object on one line. Within v1, Eywa may add message types, fields, attributes, kinds, reasons and error codes; consumers should ignore what they don't recognize. See docs/api.md.

Request.description: The one line a consumer sends after connecting.

op.description: get: one snapshot, then the connection closes. subscribe: a snapshot, then every change. stop: shut Eywa down.

view.description: tree: the nodes at and below path, down to depth. requests: every open request, as a flat list.

path.description: Tree view only. The node to start at.

depth.description: Tree view only. How many levels below path to include; 0 is the node alone.

Snapshot.description: Every row in the selection, sorted by id. Always the first message; it replaces everything the consumer knew.

Upsert.description: A row appeared or changed. Replace the whole row.

Error.description: The request was rejected. Eywa closes the connection after it.

code.description: bad_request: the request isn't an object or a field is invalid. unsupported_version: v isn't 1.

Stopping.description: The answer to stop. Eywa then closes every connection and exits.

Revision.description: Goes up by one with every change Eywa publishes, and starts again from zero when Eywa restarts. Never compare revisions from different connections.

NodeId.description: A node's path: / for the machine, /<client> for a client, then one <kind>:<name> segment per level. Treat it as an opaque key.

State.description: Derived from the node's whole subtree. The first that applies: needs_input (an open request), working (an open turn or subagent), unknown (something open Eywa can't confirm), idle.

Reason.description: Why a request is waiting on the user.

Row.description: The published view of one node, summarizing its whole subtree.

reason.description: Present only when state is needs_input.

cause.description: Present when state isn't idle: the node responsible for the state, possibly this one.

counts.description: Present only on machine and client rows.

attrs.description: Facts about the node, by kind. Possibly empty.

Counts.description: The open sessions beneath a machine or client row, in total and by state. The four states add up to sessions.

Observes.description: What a client lets Eywa see, so a consumer can tell really idle from can't see.

approvals.description: actor: attributed to the subagent or main thread that asked. turn: only to the turn. none: not visible.

questions.description: Questions to the user are visible.

interrupts.description: hook: the client reports interrupted turns. inferred: Eywa infers them.

cwd.description: The working directory, as an absolute path.

pid.description: The agent process the session runs in. Several sessions can share one.

surface.description: Where the session runs. Claude Code entry points Eywa doesn't recognize pass through unchanged.

last_turn.description: How the most recent turn ended. Missing until a turn ends, and while the latest turn's outcome is still being settled: after an interrupt it follows the idle state by up to two seconds.

model.description: The model the session's main thread runs on, as the client names it. Missing until the client names it. Names aren't translated, so they aren't comparable across clients.

origin.description: Claude Code only. person: the user sent the prompt. machine: something else did.

agent_type.description: The kind of subagent, as the client names it. Missing until the client names it; it can arrive in a later upsert.

prompted.description: The client confirmed it is showing the request to the user.

tool_name.description: The tool the request is for, as the client names it. Missing when the client doesn't say which tool.

mcp_server.description: On mcp_input requests: the MCP server asking. Missing when the client doesn't say.
